exec: i=0; while [ ! -d /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus ] && [ $i -lt 120 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i + 1)); done; nvidia-smi -pm 1 && nvidia-smi -pl 250 && nvidia-smi -lgc 210,1500

modprobe nct6775; i=0; nct=; ec=; while [ $i -lt 60 ]; do for d in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do case $(cat $d/name) in nct6798) nct=$d ;; asusec) ec=$d ;; esac; done; [ -n "$nct" ] && [ -n "$ec" ] && break; sleep 1; i=$((i + 1)); done; t=; for l in $ec/temp*_label; do [ "$(cat $l)" = T_Sensor ] && t=${l%_label}_input; done; [ -n "$nct" ] && [ -n "$t" ] || { echo "fan-curve: no nct6798 or asusec T_Sensor"; exit 1; }; saved=; for n in 1 2 3 4 5 7; do saved="$saved $n:$(cat $nct/pwm${n}_enable)"; done; restore() { for s in $saved; do echo ${s#*:} >$nct/pwm${s%%:*}_enable; done; exit 0; }; trap restore TERM INT; for n in 1 2 3 4 5 7; do echo 1 >$nct/pwm${n}_enable; done; echo "fan-curve: $t, pwm 100-255 over 32-42 C"; while :; do c=$(cat $t) || c=99000; if [ "$c" -le 32000 ]; then p=100; elif [ "$c" -ge 42000 ]; then p=255; else p=$((100 + (c - 32000) * 155 / 10000)); fi; for n in 1 2 3 4 5 7; do echo $p >$nct/pwm$n; done; sleep 5 & wait $!; done
